answer: Established standing decays: it demands a passing answer inside a rolling 6-epoch window, so each identity must keep relighting its own beacon of recent honest work. The narrow inlet to voting and jury seats opens only for currently-lit accounts; let the window lapse and the account rots into an inert relic carrying zero weight. This kills pre-aging dormant sock-puppets: an attacker wanting 1,000 live identities must fund 1,000 fresh original answers every epoch, forever, not stockpile them cheaply offline, so the recurring per-head cost never amortizes.
